
```sh
pip install libstb==VERSION_STRING
```

Wheels: `cp312-abi3` (covers Python 3.12+) and one wheel each for cp39, cp310 and cp311, for Windows, Linux (glibc + musl) and macOS (universal2), plus the sdist. Download them from the assets of [RELEASE_NAME](https://github.com/MohammadRaziei/libstb/releases/tag/RELEASE_NAME).
